site.name: Zaid
site.description: Zaid builds practical web products and writes about psychology, human behavior, and critical thinking.
site.bio: I build small web products, each solving one narrow problem, and I write about the psychology that explains why people use them or ignore them. Everything linked on this site is live and open to inspect.
hero.description: I'm Zaid. I design and ship web products, then write about the human behavior behind them. Three products are live right now, and every claim on this site links to something you can open.
about.label: About
about.heading: Who I am
about.body: I like problems that look soft and turn out to be technical. A wallpaper site, an oversize streetwear store, a video downloader — each one started with a question about how people actually behave, not with a feature list. I build the thing, watch what people do with it, then write down what I learned.
